text: Kayong (Ca Giong) is an Austro-Asiatic language of Vietnam. Speakers are officially classified by the Vietnamese government as Sedang people. Kayong (Ca-dong) is spoken in Sa Thầy District and Kon Plông District of Kon Tum Province (Lê et al. 2014:175) [2]

title: Kayong language (Vietnam) — Grokipedia
text: Kayong, also known as Ca Giong, is a North Bahnaric language of the Austroasiatic family spoken primarily in Kon Tum Province in the Central Highlands of Vietnam. It serves as the primary language for a subgroup of the Xo Dang (Sedang) ethnic community, with speakers officially classified by the Vietnamese government as belonging to the Sedang people.
